THE ACCOUNTS’ COMMITTED FIGURE — CLIENT VALUE OF LINES AT ORDERED AND LATER; NOT FUNDS DISBURSED

Authority → plan → committed → moved. Moved is the accounts’ committed figure — the client value of schedule lines at ordered, in production, shipped, delivered or installed — not funds disbursed, and not the contractually owed total above it. Absorbs today’s four separate bands: design authority, working budget, authorizations & trade scopes, the accounts.

WORKING BUDGET · NOT STARTED
